feeds.title: Booooooom
feeds.description: Booooooom is a highly regarded art blog founded in 2008 by Vancouver-based artist Jeff Hamada. As Canada's most trafficked art platform and one of the largest on the Internet, Booooooom has carved out a significant niche in the contemporary arts scene. The blog is dedicated to showcasing emerging artists and has played a pivotal role in launching numerous young artists' careers globally. Jeff Hamada, the creative force behind Booooooom, has built a platform that not only celebrates creativity but also fosters a vibrant community of artists and art enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Win Dinn Art, Etc.

feeds.title: Argyle Fine Art
feeds.description: Argyle Fine Art is a commercial fine art gallery located in downtown Halifax on BARRINGTON STREET!! The gallery showcases the talents of emerging artists to established artists, ranging in a variety of mediums. There is always something new or an event happening at Argyle Fine Art. Follow this blog to know more.

feeds.description: The Art of Brandy Saturley blog delves into the life and art of Brandy Saturley. Brandy Saturley is a Canadian artist known for her vibrant and captivating paintings that capture the spirit of Canadian culture and identity.

feeds.title: Visual Arts News
feeds.description: Visual Arts News is the only magazine dedicated to contemporary visual art in Atlantic Canada. The magazine is committed to providing balanced, engaging information about visual arts and artists in Nova Scotia and Atlantic Canada. They prioritize work that pushes back against white supremacy and colonialism because they are committed to supporting anti-oppression, anti-racism, Indigenous sovereignty, Black liberation, and sexual and gender diversity.

feeds.title: Fine Art Collector-Canadian Art Gallery
feeds.description: FineArtCollector.ca is Canada's leading online art gallery, selling Canadian fine art by major artists. Your art auction alternative to buy & sell art. Our mission is to educate people about the beauty and value of Canadian fine art, and share our philosophy that collecting great art can be and should be affordable.

feeds.title: The Jealous Curator Blog
feeds.description: The Jealous Curator launched in 2009, as a place for me to show artwork that 'made me jealous'. Yes, I was jealous of other artists' work, their lives, their success, their studios.

feeds.title: James Rottman Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: We are the experts in Canadian Post-War and contemporary art. James Rottman Fine Art buys, sells and appraises Canadian art.

feeds.title: C. Foster Art Blog
feeds.description: A lover of flowers, travel, dogs, and inspired recipes, Chris turned to painting as a hobby in 2016. She quickly caught the bug of being surrounded by colour. Painting became her 'Happy Place'. The challenges of light, texture, and colour keep this developing artist focused and motivated to create. Always a student - learning from established artists as well as her peers - and discovering that self-doubt and a critical eye are part and parcel of becoming a painter. Acrylics, Oils, Collage, Mixed Media and Chinese Water Colours are all part of her discovery.

feeds.title: Justin G​edak​ Blog
feeds.description: Gothic art, dark fantasy and medieval fantasy art blog by digital artist Justin Gedak. His series of gothic fantasy digital portrait paintings are themed around the concept of individuals who have gone through times of trouble, and survived to be stronger for it.

feeds.title: Dorothea LeBlanc Art Blog
feeds.description: A heart to help this world by reducing, reusing and recycling things inspires me to create lusciously textured paintings (which actually fulfill my in-born desire to make sculpture). When working this way I experience a completely different creative process than when painting realistically. Dorothea's Art Studio blog describes and illustrates my art making process.
